articles.headline: MongoDB 9.0 promises higher throughput and faster scaling for unpredictable workloads
articles.summary: MongoDB’s latest release focuses on better performance and elasticity, which matters for businesses handling variable demand and AI-related workloads. The updates could lower scaling pain for teams running customer-facing apps, analytics, or operational systems that need to grow quickly without major infrastructure rework.

articles.headline: Enterprises are blowing AI budgets as cheaper open-weight models gain appeal
articles.summary: Enterprise AI spending pressure is pushing companies to look for lower-cost models for routine work. That can reshape procurement decisions, cloud usage, and vendor strategy for firms trying to control AI operating costs without slowing adoption.

articles.headline: AI build-out tightens supply of memory, semiconductors, servers, optics, and power gear
articles.summary: The AI infrastructure boom is raising demand and costs across data-center equipment, especially memory and advanced chips. For businesses, that can mean higher cloud and infrastructure costs, longer lead times, and more pressure on procurement planning.
